$description: Semantic layout tier (mode-independent). --mf-max-content-width is a single scalar governing the max width page content grows to. --mf-content-margins-lr / --mf-content-margins-tb are the base inputs for the per-band content-margin ladders; each band derives from its axis's base via a compiler-baked multiplier. DTCG has no calc primitive, so each derived token carries BOTH the pre-computed literal $value (so the compiled default matches the design exactly) AND the band + multiplier in $extensions, letting task 002 emit calc(var(--mf-content-margins-<axis>) * k) so a runtime base override cascades to every band — the same dual-carry pattern semantic/radius.json uses for com.moduleforge.radius. See tokens/README.md and plan/notes/token-shape-decision.md.

max-content-width.$description: Max width page content grows to. Single scalar, no bands.

content-margins-lr.$description: Base input for the inline-axis content-margin ladder. Rescales all six bands.

content-margins-tb.$description: Base input for the block-axis content-margin ladder. Rescales all six bands.

content-margins-lr-base.$description: Inline content margin at the base band (< --breakpoint-sm). Derived: content-margin-base * 1.

content-margins-lr-sm.$description: Inline content margin at the sm band (>= --breakpoint-sm). Derived: content-margin-base * 1.5.

content-margins-lr-md.$description: Inline content margin at the md band (>= --breakpoint-md). Derived: content-margin-base * 1.5.

content-margins-lr-lg.$description: Inline content margin at the lg band (>= --breakpoint-lg). Derived: content-margin-base * 2.

content-margins-lr-xl.$description: Inline content margin at the xl band (>= --breakpoint-xl). Derived: content-margin-base * 2.

content-margins-lr-2xl.$description: Inline content margin at the 2xl band (>= --breakpoint-2xl). Derived: content-margin-base * 2.

content-margins-tb-base.$description: Block content margin at the base band (< --breakpoint-sm). Derived: content-margin-base * 1.5.

content-margins-tb-sm.$description: Block content margin at the sm band (>= --breakpoint-sm). Derived: content-margin-base * 1.5.

content-margins-tb-md.$description: Block content margin at the md band (>= --breakpoint-md). Derived: content-margin-base * 1.5.

content-margins-tb-lg.$description: Block content margin at the lg band (>= --breakpoint-lg). Derived: content-margin-base * 2.

content-margins-tb-xl.$description: Block content margin at the xl band (>= --breakpoint-xl). Derived: content-margin-base * 2.

content-margins-tb-2xl.$description: Block content margin at the 2xl band (>= --breakpoint-2xl). Derived: content-margin-base * 2.
